page_purpose: This page is used to view and manage a list of all inventory items, goods, and services available in Zoho Books.
summary: The 'All Items' page in Zoho Books provides a comprehensive list of all goods and services, including their names, purchase descriptions, rates, and usage units. It serves as a central hub for users to oversee their inventory and add new items as needed.
